notes: 0.5.0：脚本列表支持分组。分组是视图，不是磁盘目录——脚本文件一个都不移动，分组信息存在 settings.json 里，所以整个安装目录换位置、换盘符都不影响。列表里组头是一行：三角 + 组名 + 运行中/成员数，右边三列是该组正在运行的脚本的 CPU / GPU / 内存合计（不含工作台本体，状态栏那一行才含）。组头右键可全部运行 / 全部停止 / 重命名 / 删除分组；脚本行右键新增「移动到 ▸」，一个脚本只属一组。删除分组只解散，成员回到「未分组」，不删任何文件。搜索框有内容时分组暂时隐去，结果扁平并列、折叠的组里也能搜到。另一个变化：列表只认 Scripts\ 根下的 .ahk，不再进子目录找脚本；附件与运行时产物放同级同名文件夹 Scripts\脚本名\。0.4.x 的包安装布局会在第一次扫描时自动搬成平铺，文件夹保留为数据目录。
notes_en: 0.5.0: the script list can now be grouped. A group is a view, not a folder - no file is moved; groups live in settings.json, so relocating the whole installation keeps them. A group header is its own row: caret, name, running/total, and the CPU / GPU / memory sum of that group's running scripts (the deck's own process is excluded - only the status bar counts it). Right-click a header to run or stop the whole group, rename it, or delete it; right-click a script for "Move to >" (one script, one group). Deleting a group only disbands it - members fall back to Ungrouped and no file is deleted. While the search box has text the groups are hidden and the result is one flat, column-sorted list, including hits inside folded groups. Also: the list now reads only Scripts\*.ahk - subfolders are never searched - and a script's attachments and runtime output live in the sibling folder Scripts\<name>\. Installs from the 0.4.x package layout are lifted to the flat name on the first scan, with the folder kept as the data folder.
